description: Move a task that has not gone live to another day of the calendar (YYYY-MM-DD, from today to situation.horizon.end). A task still waiting for its day moves with its release (moved into the week ahead, it goes to its engine at once); one already with its engine keeps going and only its day changes. Say why in plain words. It needs an act key.

date.description: The new day, YYYY-MM-DD, from today to the horizon's end.

id.description: The work row's id, from work_list.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: Why it moves, in plain words; the owner reads it.

name: work_reschedule
title: Work reschedule
